coverage_note: SCL-valid sample is 93% Arunachal Pradesh, nearly all Uttarakhand and most Sikkim dropped -- a real coverage skew, but NOT the explanation for the mask effect, since qa60_matched_subsample_wilcoxon_p (QA60 on the identical SCL-valid villages) is still null (p=0.449) while scl_wilcoxon_p on those same villages is significant (p=0.000005). The mask choice itself, not sample composition, drives the difference.
